review.recipe: Short wide heatproof tumbler, clear golden hot toddy, single long lemon ribbon inside; saucer inverted and damp just lifted. No ice/flame/extra garnish; only faint steam. Fully dissolved sugar, plausible fill.
review.personality: Ordinary blank-back card pack and two slightly unsquared face-down cards embody explicit private-practice source; pulled-up chair invites another person. Drying functional mugs with damp towel replace obsolete impossible water arc.
review.world: Dark walnut table, neutral black-brown room, dim lamp. Flame in v1 removed in v2; metal only legitimate practice mugs. No industrial surface.
issues: Supporting cards/saucer partly cropped on very narrow phone view; dedicated portrait recompose may be required after export inspection.
